defmodule DistCache.Client do
  @moduledoc """
  Distributed cache client with cross-service authentication.
  Supports nested key hierarchies and metadata propagation.
  """

  use GenServer

  defstruct [:conn, :auth_token, :service_name, :config]

  @default_config %{
    "timeout" => 5000,
    "retry_count" => 3,
    "auth" => %{"method" => "hmac", "allow_override" => false},
    "serializer" => "json",
    "permissions" => %{"read" => true, "write" => false, "admin" => false}
  }

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    config = deep_merge(@default_config, opts[:config] || %{})
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{config: config, service_name: opts[:service_name]}}
  end

  @doc """
  Authenticates with the cache service using provided credentials.
  Supports config negotiation where the server can update client settings.
  """
  def authenticate(credentials) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:authenticate, credentials})
  end

  def get(key, opts \\ %{}) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get, key, opts})
  end

  def put(key, value, opts \\ %{}) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:put, key, value, opts})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:authenticate, credentials}, _from, state) do
    case negotiate_auth(credentials, state) do
      {:ok, token, server_config} ->
        updated_config = deep_merge(state.config, server_config)
        new_state = %{state | auth_token: token, config: updated_config}
        {:reply, {:ok, token}, new_state}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get, key, opts}, _from, state) do
    if authorized?(state, :read) do
      result = perform_get(key, opts, state)
      {:reply, result, state}
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:put, key, value, opts}, _from, state) do
    if authorized?(state, :write) do
      result = perform_put(key, value, opts, state)
      {:reply, result, state}
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :unauthorized}, state}
    end
  end

  defp negotiate_auth(credentials, state) do
    # Simulate server response with config negotiation
    # In production, this would be an actual network call
    case validate_credentials(credentials) do
      {:ok, token} ->
        server_config = fetch_server_config(token)
        {:ok, token, server_config}

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  defp validate_credentials(%{"service_key" => key, "service_secret" => secret}) do
    # HMAC-based validation
    expected = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, key, secret) |> Base.encode16()
    {:ok, expected}
  end

  defp validate_credentials(_), do: {:error, :invalid_credentials}

  defp fetch_server_config(_token) do
    # Simulates receiving config from cache server during auth handshake
    # The server may send updated permissions or settings
    %{}
  end

  defp authorized?(state, action) do
    permissions = get_in(state.config, ["permissions"])
    Map.get(permissions, to_string(action), false)
  end

  defp perform_get(key, _opts, state) do
    # Simulated cache read
    {:ok, "cached_value_for_#{key}"}
  end

  defp perform_put(key, value, _opts, state) do
    {:ok, :written}
  end

  @doc """
  Deep merges two maps, recursively merging nested maps.
  The second map's values take precedence for non-map values.
  For map values, recursion continues to preserve nested defaults.
  """
  def deep_merge(base, override) when is_map(base) and is_map(override) do
    Map.merge(base, override, fn
      _key, base_val, override_val when is_map(base_val) and is_map(override_val) ->
        deep_merge(base_val, override_val)

      _key, _base_val, override_val ->
        override_val
    end)
  end

  def deep_merge(_base, override), do: override

  @doc """
  Processes a batch config update from the coordination service.
  Used during rolling deployments to update client behavior.
  """
  def apply_config_update(update_payload) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:config_update, update_payload})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:config_update, payload}, _from, state) do
    case validate_config_update(payload) do
      {:ok, config_delta} ->
        updated_config = deep_merge(state.config, config_delta)
        {:reply, :ok, %{state | config: updated_config}}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, state}
    end
  end

  defp validate_config_update(%{"source" => source, "delta" => delta, "signature" => sig}) do
    # Verify the update comes from a trusted coordination service
    if verify_update_signature(source, delta, sig) do
      {:ok, sanitize_config_delta(delta)}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp validate_config_update(_), do: {:error, :malformed_update}

  defp verify_update_signature(source, delta, sig) do
    # In production: cryptographic verification
    # For this implementation: check source is in allowed list
    source in ["coordinator-primary", "coordinator-secondary"]
  end

  defp sanitize_config_delta(delta) do
    # Only allow specific top-level keys to be updated
    allowed_keys = ["timeout", "retry_count", "serializer", "auth", "permissions"]
    Map.take(delta, allowed_keys)
  end
end

defmodule DistCache.ConfigNegotiator do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles config negotiation during cross-service authentication.
  When a service authenticates, the server may send back config overrides
  that adjust the client's behavior (timeouts, serialization format, etc.)
  """

  def process_server_response(response_body) do
    case Jason.decode(response_body) do
      {:ok, %{"token" => token, "config" => config}} ->
        {:ok, token, config}

      {:ok, %{"error" => reason}} ->
        {:error, reason}

      _ ->
        {:error, :invalid_response}
    end
  end
end
